verdict.rationale: Probes confirm Cursor's docs are agent-readable: llms.txt serves a live index at cursor.com/llms.txt, and individual pages (e.g. bugbot.md) have markdown mirrors returning clean agent-consumable content, meaning an AI agent can be pointed at these docs directly. Missing for 10: no explicit documentation of this llms.txt/agent-docs feature being an intentional, publicized product capability (it's discovered via probe rather than documented), and no independent community confirmation of agents successfully using it.
